terms.name: parallel_to_aorta

terms.name: flattened_cross_section
terms.note: major/minor axis ratio of the lumen blob at the seed

terms.name: hu_below_lumen
terms.note: mean trace HU well under the aortic lumen reference

terms.name: ostium_disagreement

terms.name: radius_vs_aorta
terms.note: seed radius as a fraction of the nearby aortic radius

terms.name: thin_ostium
terms.note: contact patch area vs. the vessel's own cross-section 2mm out: a real ostium is a wider funnel, not equal to or narrower than the vessel

terms.name: radius_inconsistent
terms.note: coefficient of variation of the frontier radius over the first few mm

terms.name: leak_margin
terms.note: how far this component's own HU sits above the flood's chosen threshold
